chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah the Exalted support him—informed me of, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr; and al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā; and Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Ashʿarī, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about ghusl (ritual bath) for janabah, and he said: “Pour three handfuls over your head, and over your right side, and over your left side; indeed, what suffices you is the like of oiling.”

key_terms.أَفِضْ: pour or let water flow over
key_terms.رَأْسِكَ: your head, the first part mentioned in the washing sequence
key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ritual bath required after the state of janabah
key_terms.مِثْلُ الدُّهْنِ: an amount like oiling, meaning a light but sufficient application

ai.seo_question: How should ghusl for janabah be performed according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the manner of performing ghusl for janabah. It indicates washing the head and then the right and left sides, while emphasizing that only a small, sufficient amount of water is needed.
